subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Does a security/release owner approve executing these 13 updated action revisions in the repository's token-, secret-, scanning-, publishing-, and Codex-agent workflows on the final exact head?
rationale: Green syntax and ordinary CI checks do not independently settle third-party executable-code trust, privileged workflow behavior, or the repository's mandatory direct Codex-source contract review.

options.title: Approve after exact-head review
options.body: Wait for a stable rebased SHA, complete the direct upstream and sibling-Codex source review, and merge only after the required affected checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, Docker, and Codex Action updates into smaller PRs if owners cannot confidently approve the grouped trust-boundary change.

options.title: Pause the bundle
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until Dependabot access and rebase churn stop and an owner can review a durable exact head.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head review
recommendation.body: Wait for a stable rebased SHA, complete the direct upstream and sibling-Codex source review, and merge only after the required affected checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes this security-sensitive automation bundle to steipete, and the diff includes release, token, and agent workflow surfaces.
